downloaded_dft.note: Relative polymorph energy is referenced only within the downloaded structures of the same reduced formula; it is not formation energy or Ehull.

retrospective_topology.note: These are automated high-symmetry-path screening hits, not complete topological-invariant confirmations.

surrogate_models.note: Chemical-system grouped cross-validation was used. Performance is sufficient only for prioritization and requires prospective validation.

mp20_novelty.note: Both composition-novel and structure-novel candidates are novel relative to MP20 training data; global database novelty remains unevaluated.

full_materials_project_novelty.note: MP20 analysis is complete, but a current full Materials Project snapshot is still required for a database-wide novelty claim.

publication_claims_not_yet_available.formation_energy_or_ehull: Missing compatible elemental and competing-phase DFT references.
publication_claims_not_yet_available.phonon_stability: No phonon outputs were present in calculation_results.
publication_claims_not_yet_available.fixed_budget_acceleration: The matched random-space-group and ablation arms have not received the same DFT budget.
publication_claims_not_yet_available.external_novelty: MP20-relative novelty is complete; full current Materials Project comparison is pending.
publication_claims_not_yet_available.confirmed_topological_materials: Wilson-loop/topological-invariant and expert band validation are pending.

symmcd_topology_conditioning.decision_gate: Modify SymmCD only after prospective fixed-budget selection beats the matched baselines and the post-generation selector is shown to be the bottleneck.
